verdict.rationale: Crossplane's control plane runs continuously in the background: it automatically corrects drift from desired state (crossplane-docs-18), and user-configured function pipelines return declarative configuration that Crossplane applies without a hand-written controller (crossplane-docs-32). A community user also notes the control plane handles enforcement on its own (crossplane-comm-12). However, these automations are limited to declarative reconciliation of resources, not general-purpose background automations, and the AI-facing angle is only a marketing claim (crossplane-docs-16). Missing for 10: arbitrary or scheduled automation workflows beyond resource reconciliation, documented AI/agent-driven autonomous tasks, hands-on evidence of autonomous operation in practice.
